entries.journal:
Two years in here, almost to the day. I scrolled back to the first entry, the one about not being able to remember last month. I can remember this one. Most of it, anyway.

What changed was never one decision. It was going back to the gym on a Wednesday, reading ten pages instead of scrolling, saying yes to a spare ticket. Then doing it again.
